notes: Two routes that the text writes out in full for each, so no shared tail. The first ends at Abu Salama: the text names no Companion for it, and «بمثله» points at the second route, which reaches Aisha.
«- يعني ابن سلام -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
«أنه سأل عائشة» makes Aisha the last link, since her answer is the saying (rule 5).
